clips.title: The story
paras: Thork orders a strike against the Razormane raids on the Horde road. Kreenig Snarlsnout leads the attacks from the northern Barrens, and his death is meant to break the warband's hold on the route between Durotar and the Crossroads.

The road between Durotar and the Crossroads carries provisions and reinforcements through the northern Barrens. Razormane quilboar ambushes have kept it under threat. Scout reports name their leader as Kreenig Snarlsnout, whose raiding party organizes the attacks. Thork orders a strike against Kreenig, hoping to break the warband's unity and secure the road.

Kreenig's war party is entrenched in craggy hills northeast of the Crossroads. Hardy Razormane Defenders and geomancers who manipulate the arid earth shield his position. Thork's order is to break through that guard and strike Kreenig in his redoubt, sending a warning across the plains. His tusk will prove the leader's death and show that the Horde will not accept attacks on its lifelines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, friend. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.
To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, friend. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.
The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.
Your people should be proud to count you among them.
